Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: 87 Missing After Ferry Fire in Palawan
caption:
A ferry fire off Coron, Philippines, has left 87 of 134 people aboard unaccounted for. The coast guard says the toll is based on live data and may still change as search efforts continue.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Iranian Strikes Damage Eight F-15 Jets in Jordan
caption:
Iranian strikes on a Jordanian base in Azraq damaged eight US F-15 jets and cost an A-10 its wing, officials say, as US forces fired 30 Patriot missiles to defend the site. Iran's Revolutionary Guard has vowed to strike 20 US targets for every Iranian target hit.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Houthis Seize Mokha, 75km From Bab al-Mandab
caption:
Houthi forces have captured the Red Sea port of Mokha, 75 kilometers from the Bab al-Mandab strait, giving the group a coastal position to threaten tankers with shore-based missiles and radar. Fighting has reportedly killed hundreds, and Houthi forces are now advancing on Dhubab, closer to the strait.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Houthis Seize Yemen's Mocha Port, Oil Spikes
caption:
Houthi forces captured Yemen's Red Sea port of Mocha Thursday, adding to pressure on oil markets as traders price a 70% chance the Fed raises rates next week. A stronger dollar would make oil more expensive for import-dependent economies like Nigeria, whose naira has already fallen 2.9% in 29 days.

Full story in the app — link in bio.

headline: Amazon Jet Overran Runway After 4-Second Delay
caption:
A cargo jet overran the runway in Miami after pilots released the brakes four seconds late, NTSB data show, killing five. Investigators say a go-around attempt after touchdown may have blocked the spoilers the brakes needed to stop.
